projects.title: Procurement-to-delivery flow reset
projects.description: A multi-plant supplier faced growing lead times and rising inventory despite strong demand. GroEdge redesigned the end-to-end material and information flow—from planning signals to dispatch—so plants could promise dates they could keep.
achievements: Common standards rolled out across 4 regional plants

projects.title: Lean transformation on critical product lines
projects.description: Capacity was capped by long changeovers and unstable quality. We ran value-stream mapping, SMED, and standard work with production teams—then locked gains with a daily management rhythm.
achievements: Critical equipment setup time cut by 60%
Supervisors and operators certified in Lean fundamentals

projects.title: Distribution centre redesign for growth
projects.description: An 80,000 sq ft DC needed to absorb ~30% volume growth without a matching jump in labour cost. We redesigned layout, slotting, and pick paths, then restaffed roles around the new flow.
achievements: Zero recordable safety incidents over the following 12 months

projects.title: Operational diligence & site consolidation
projects.description: Pre-deal operational diligence identified integration risks and synergy levers. Post-close, GroEdge supported consolidation of two manufacturing sites and alignment of processes without disrupting key accounts.
achievements: Unified ERP and management reporting in year one
Zero missed commitments to priority customers during cutover
